test_case.name: Node Not Ready (PLEG Unhealthy & Container Runtime Hang)
test_case.scenario_description: Worker node 'node-worker-11' hosting pod 'order-processor-6d4f8b9a2-h5j8k' (container 'order-consumer', namespace 'orders') suffers a containerd runtime deadlock. Kubelet's Pod Lifecycle Event Generator (PLEG) fails relist health checks after exceeding the 3m0s timeout (last seen active 4m12s ago). The node transitions to NodeNotReady and the node controller initiates pod eviction.
test_case.injected_fault: containerd CRI socket deadlock on node-worker-11 causes kubelet PLEG relist timeout (>3m0s) and NodeNotReady state transition.
test_case.ground_truth_rca: Worker node 'node-worker-11' transitioned to NodeNotReady because the kubelet Pod Lifecycle Event Generator (PLEG) became unhealthy ('pleg was last seen active 4m12s ago; threshold is 3m0s') due to an unresponsive containerd CRI runtime socket, disrupting pod 'order-processor-6d4f8b9a2-h5j8k'.

suggested_remediation: Inspect cluster node capacities and allocatable resources: `kubectl describe nodes | grep -A 8 'Allocated resources'`.
Verify pod resource requests and limits (`spec.containers[*].resources`) to ensure they match workload needs and node sizing.
Investigate unhealthy node and container runtime: `kubectl describe node <node-name>` and `journalctl -u kubelet -u containerd -n 100`.
